title: Muhammad Zahid Iqbal Portfolio
shortDesc: Official personal portfolio of Muhammad Zahid Iqbal — WordPress Developer & Technical SEO Specialist. Features single-page smooth scroll architecture, interactive portfolio chat, dark glass aesthetic, and 90+ Lighthouse score.
longDesc: Designed and engineered an Awwwards-caliber one-page developer portfolio with a dark glass design system, smooth Lenis scrolling, mouse-reactive particle background, interactive portfolio chat, and full SEO optimization.

title: Chitrali Saughat
shortDesc: Ecommerce website showcasing authentic Chitrali products including woolen shawls, pakols, dry fruits, shilajit, and traditional handicrafts. Built using WordPress and WooCommerce with a focus on user experience and online sales.
longDesc: Designed and developed a complete e-commerce website for Chitrali Saughat, a brand selling handmade products from the Chitral region of Pakistan. Implemented WooCommerce with custom product pages, wishlist functionality, cart and checkout flows, SEO-optimised meta data, Open Graph images, and free-delivery logic. Integrated Apple Pay and Google Pay. Achieved a Lighthouse performance score above 90.

title: Upper Hand Organization
shortDesc: Designed and developed a nonprofit organization website focused on donations, community support, education initiatives, medical assistance, housing projects, and relief programs in northern Pakistan.
longDesc: Built the full web presence for Upper Hand Organization, a Pakistan-based nonprofit providing housing, clean water, medical care, and disaster relief. Delivered animated impact stats (2.5K families helped, 50+ students supported, 43 water projects), a cause-listing system with individual donation pages, a member login/register flow, WhatsApp contact integration, and SEO with structured data markup.

title: A One Patti House Chitral
shortDesc: Built a modern ecommerce platform for traditional Chitrali clothing and handmade wool products, including shawls, caps, coats, waistcoats, and accessories. Integrated WooCommerce and optimized user experience for online shopping.
longDesc: Developed a product-focused WooCommerce store for A One Patti House Chitral. Configured custom product categories, regional delivery rules, an SVG favicon, Tailwind-inspired dark theme (#181818), and full on-page SEO including Twitter Card and Open Graph metadata. Ensured mobile-first responsive design across all breakpoints.
